item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence of Srettha resisting inspections, undermining treaties, or using disarmament language in bad faith.\nI also did not find a 2024 source showing him personally negotiating a new arms-control treaty or inspection regime; the evidence is mostly official participation, reaffirmation, and diplomatic tone.\nSo the best-supported reading is positive continuity: Thailand under Srettha publicly backed the major nonproliferation and disarmament frameworks, with no reliable contrary evidence located.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand co-chaired the 15th ASEAN Regional Forum Inter-Sessional Meeting on Non-Proliferation and Disarmament in Honolulu, Hawaii","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"May 3, 2024","url":"https://mfa.go.th/en/content/arfismonnpd-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand reaffirmed support for strengthening and transparency in nuclear nonproliferation and disarmament, and said the goal is the total elimination of nuclear weapons.
